cs.t: For audio I use the MEE M6 earphones with Comply foam tips (the tips really make a world of difference). For video and microphone, I use the Logitech ConferenceCam Connect and consistently get complemented on my video and audio quality, but I wouldn't recommmend it to others due to the price – I only use it because I was able to get it for free through a promotion.
